repair.behavior: Ordinary requests started during pair/logout are retired before response status processing, including an old-bearer 401 that arrives before pairing commits.

component_test.coverage: responses before/during pair and logout; early old-bearer 401 cannot emit expiry or cancel successful pairing; signed-out request has no Authorization

full_web_validation.command: npm test -- --run && npm run build && npm run build:local

limitations: The exact early-401 transition ordering is deterministic module evidence; the real-browser smoke rechecks the existing stale-401 and duplicate-submit product paths.
